metric_definitions.C: RMST over [0,8] / 8 = (1 + sum(a_r, r=1..7)) / 8; event time is the first departure round
metric_definitions.loss: (8-r_first)/8, equally divided among departures in the first departure round
metric_definitions.goal: Game mean of non-EXIT share of pre-solve TALK responses eligible to exit; includes singleton solver
metric_definitions.all4_completion: Separate endpoint: all four agents remain after round 8; C=1 alone does not imply this
